_comment: Copy this file to acceptance.settings.json (git-ignored) in this same folder and replace every CHANGE_ME with your own disposable, local-only values. Never commit acceptance.settings.json -- it is your machine's local secrets file for a throwaway test stack, not a deployment artifact.
_databaseComment: ace_cloud is created beside this disposable test world's ace_shard schema because custody invariants require cross-schema triggers. aceShardConnectionString supplies the local admin identity for migrations; dbUser/dbPassword define the restricted companion-service identity, granted full access to ace_cloud plus narrow read-only SELECT on exactly ace_shard.character and ace_shard.biota_properties_i_i_d for character/allegiance name resolution -- never broad ace_shard.* access.
_worldComment: Point these at a separately started ACE test world built from this PR branch -- this launcher never starts or bootstraps ACE itself unless you opt into aceServerProjectPath below. worldBoundaryHealthEndpoint is ACE's own CloudMule.HealthEndpoint (default port 9600); the deposit-readiness diagnostic lives alongside it at /cloudmule/deposit-readiness on the same origin.
_externalDatabaseComment: Your already-existing ace_shard and ace_world databases, used ONLY for a read-only reachability check (Prepare-LocalAcceptanceCloudDatabase.ps1 and Test-AceWorldReadiness.ps1 run 'SELECT 1' against these -- they are never created, migrated, or purged by this launcher; only the disposable ace_cloud database is).
_versionComment: The exact Cloud schema/ACE-extension/contract protocol versions this PR branch expects (matching Backend/Worker's own ExpectedAceExtensionVersion/ExpectedContractProtocolVersion defaults). Only change these if you know your ACE test world's CloudMule extension reports different versions.
_managedAceComment: Optional. Leave blank (the default) to manage your own separately started ACE test world -- Start-LocalAcceptance.ps1 will then just wait for worldBoundaryHealthEndpoint and print instructions. Set this to the path of your ACE.Server project (e.g. '..\..\Source\ACE.Server') to have Start-LocalAcceptance.ps1 also start/restart it as a managed background process, the same way it manages AuthBridge/Backend/Worker -- it is still never used against a non-disposable ACE instance; only point this at a test world you are willing to have this launcher restart.
_testAccountsComment: Synthetic accounts you create on your disposable ACE test world for this launcher only -- never a real player's credentials.
